raw_text: There is a place near Snoqualmie that's right off the highway, down one of the numerous side roads in the middle of nowhere. It seemed like it had been a maintained campground for large groups once upon a time except there wasn't more than the one large spot. You would have to drive down this dirt "road" that was perilous for trucks and dangerous for smaller cars that would lead directly to a loop that had two or three smaller spots and a massive central area. All of it cleared out of trees and any major debris, and after every winter somebody would come clear out downed trees and other obstructions. We went out there more times than I can remember, as home base for weeks we would do multiple hikes or a long weekend with large groups where we'd spend the night with a large fire and questionable substances. We got older, people moved away, and I can't think of reason I'd ever go back there now that I'm old and grey. It was a place that promised adventure, or a good time the second you turned on that unassuming side road to get there.
